data: Bybit public trade archive (public.bybit.com/trading), never used before. Minute bars: last trade price, signed taker notional, notional volume. Day kept if >= 80% of minutes have trades.
inference: Clark-West (Newey-West 6 lags); 2,000 date-block bootstrap draws; secondary Holm-adjusted

primary.success: Clark-West one-sided p < 0.05 AND 95% date-block bootstrap CI of dR2 above 0

question: Second venue: does the depth-free amplification statistic forecast next-hour adverse excursions on Bybit USDT perpetuals of the Binance thin-set coins?
runs: W6 is run once; every run is counted in prereg/test_set_unlocks_p7.json
secondary: position-sizing backtest, same definitions as Part 6 B: amp_vol (R = rv_360 * GM^theta, GM = S60/|h_0| from the depth-free impulse response, theta chosen on Bybit training data) vs vol
statistic: C3_flow = kappa^2 eta q - (1-a) kappa from dp = kappa u - (1-a) x and u_t = (1-eta) u_t-1 + eta q x_t-1 (T6 without depth)
unit: symbol-hour blocks, hours 6-23 UTC; features [t-360, t); outcome (t, t+60]
